H0.source: official DESI DR2 + CMB LambdaCDM determination (DESI Collaboration 2025a, arXiv:2503.14738); the committed chains chain_lcdm_desi_cmb*.npy give 68.35 +/- 0.33 -- the hyperbola anchors on the published value

rd.source: Planck sound horizon (fixed prior mean in all chains)

note: Relative errors 0.41% and 0.18% are independent (CMB chain H0 vs Planck rd), so quadrature addition is exact to Monte Carlo precision.
